findings.title: V18 permits a development gap in place of required exchange
findings.evidence: FR-18 requires declared electrical, thermal, EMC and CAD exchanges. V18 says each discipline has a supported exchange or an explicit outstanding development item. That records a design gap but does not establish the mandatory exchange. EG-01 requires implemented requirement-specific verdicts.
findings.suggested_minimal_fix: For every profile required by the frozen minimum, require successful reference request/result exchange and semantic checks before V18 passes. A required missing profile leaves its obligation unverified or undetermined. Retain gap reporting and require reviewed disposition for reduced scope.
findings.current_claim_limit: No current passing implementation verdict was asserted. This is a prospective acceptance defect.

findings.title: IF-03 implies a checked OpenModelica profile exists
findings.evidence: The rule says 'Integrated OpenModelica has a checked local profile'. Candidate FR-16/18/20/23 records state profiles and tests are proposed. review-0793 Section 4.4, PDF page 7, concerns a separate ENOVIA/SIMULIA model and reports synchronization and library limits.
findings.suggested_minimal_fix: Say the proposed integrated backend requires a checked local profile and its implementation/verification are pending. Use proposed-status wording for external service profiles too.

findings.title: No explicit black-box variation or imposed-constraint review
findings.evidence: Other black-box products are present, but expected requirements variation and imposed realization constraints are not recorded or explicitly tailored. Later PA risks do not close those black-box tasks. OOSEM 17.3.3, printed pages 453–454, physical PDF pages 461–462, identifies both activities.
findings.suggested_minimal_fix: Add a compact variation/constraint paragraph or table. Cover changing loads/modes, components, analysis/software profiles and later facility interfaces. Link to change isolation and declared adaptation. State no universal vendor, repository, hard budget or external-only RM/MD/SA restriction is evidenced. Distinguish the study's SysML v2 description rule from candidate implementation choices. Unknown likelihood stays unknown.

findings.title: Qualitative verification field applicability remains inconsistent
findings.evidence: FR-28 lists quantities for every activity, while its PA-VS realization says quantities or applicable conditions and the record type accepts observable responses. FR-01 explicitly allows qualitative demonstrations. V28 includes inspection and demonstration.
findings.suggested_minimal_fix: Attach an explicit FR-28 field-applicability interpretation: quantities when applicable, observable conditions otherwise, rationale for inapplicable fields. Add a qualitative inspection/demonstration fixture to V28. No new leaf or owner is needed.

findings.title: Observation/comparison and analytical-verdict inputs are implicit
findings.evidence: F04 outputs ExpectedObservedComparison and covers FR-25 without an ObservationPackage input. F07 accepts ObservationPackage without that comparison output. F06 declares no RunPackage input for analytical-result admissibility. The logical L05/L06/L07 thread provides the intended flow, but the black-box signatures leave controlled input resolution implicit.
findings.suggested_minimal_fix: Declare observation and run-package inputs at the relevant service, or explicitly define exact package resolution from the baseline manifest. Preserve all eight function IDs and existing record types.
findings.qualification: This is an incomplete contract description. The logical architecture has not lost the observation flow.

findings.title: Updated V01 fixture differs from allocation copies
findings.evidence: The reviewed V01 explicitly exercises quantitative and qualitative requirements and inapplicable-field rationale. Copies retain the older generic round-trip fixture despite corrected requirement wording.
findings.suggested_minimal_fix: Propagate the revised V01 fixture or reference one authoritative verification-case revision instead of copying text.

checks_satisfied.evidence: 144 concerns, 30 roots, 114 unchanged causal edges and seven unchanged aliases. Exact ID/text/source/citation/parent/reference fields match original register.

checks_satisfied.name: End-to-end common coverage
checks_satisfied.evidence: Every concern has direct FR and need traces. Every FR is covered by black-box functions and scenarios.

checks_satisfied.name: Reviewed candidate allocation integrity
checks_satisfied.evidence: All 120 COM/CDT/VS allocations match accepted primary/supporting L order. Physical IDs resolve. Embedded and separate allocations agree. V01–V40 are present and planned.

checks_satisfied.name: Logical neutrality and method order
checks_satisfied.evidence: Needs, black box, logical, candidate and trade stages are ordered coherently. Logical capabilities impose no vendor, GPU or executable count. Later allocation columns are trace overlays.

checks_satisfied.name: RAM, credibility, software and technician mechanisms
checks_satisfied.evidence: Named RAM transformations use explicit failure dependencies and expert references. Calibration/validation, raw data/masks, both software profiles, target evidence and safe handoff have specific proposed mechanisms. No achieved RAM or physical safety is inferred.

checks_satisfied.name: Common system boundary and subjects
checks_satisfied.evidence: All five lineages cover broader engineering responsibilities. Solver placement is declared. Framework assets, case artifacts, EPS acceptance, model adequacy, facility authority and project assessment remain distinct.

checks_satisfied.name: Conditional selection and cost concern
checks_satisfied.evidence: PA-VS is an analyst reuse-first choice. Native services and narrow bridge evidence support that priority. Cost/access/export/reconstruction can reverse selection. No invented budget or user preference appears.

checks_satisfied.name: No fabricated performance or approval
checks_satisfied.evidence: All empirical candidate MOEs/Pareto/utilities are pending. Evidence categories are not scores. No prototype pass, current cost/effort/accuracy, stakeholder approval or procurement authorization was found.

checks_satisfied.name: Capella bridge evidence scope
checks_satisfied.evidence: In-application runtime, name/parent matching, function-text import and mode-list transfer are limited appropriately. No demonstrated headless bridge or executable-transition preservation receives credit.

checks_satisfied.name: CSRM runtime limits and custom technology preservation
checks_satisfied.evidence: Source audits and syntax/semantic checks are separated from execution. Metadata units, unbound inputs, mirrored generated relations and empty-input predicates are not treated as runtime validity. Mandatory CPU core and activated OpenUSD/Omniverse/Isaac/FMI/EPS/battery path remain visible.

checks_satisfied.evidence: Handbook Part One I.1–I.6/subsections and OOSEM 17.3.4/5/7/8 locators are appropriate. No nonexistent I.1.16 source is cited as read.
